metric_definitions.sessions: One shared session regardless of two attempted measurements
metric_definitions.detection: Repeat or higher from physiological evidence acquired on/after onset; technical quality Repeat excluded
metric_definitions.delay: Mean among detected events only; missed count always reported alongside
metric_definitions.false_escalations: Healthy outcome reaching Consult/Urgent, counted per assessment day per mission convention; unique astronauts also reported

crossover: No validated crossover claim: model and precedence remain pending independent confirmation. Raw paired differences are available for engineering inspection.
limitations: Sequential evidence aggregation was not specified. Engineering fixtures use only the latest usable measurement's decayed log LR, never multiply correlated observations; this preserves the historical venous restriction.

Readable degraded evidence at 0.2 log weight conflicts with the historical exclusion rule. Relayed shared-session failures do not specify degraded/failed split; engineering fixtures retain the historically approved 50/50 split and +0.4mm off-axis bias, pending confirmation for jugular quality.

Venous baseline distribution and measurement-noise distribution were not specified. Engineering fixtures use positive-truncated normal baseline and Gaussian proportional noise; neither is activated for experiments.

Adaptive required trigger evidence conditions and usable-recent-scan window were not fully specified. Fixtures interpret recent as the 3-day lookback and require an observable trigger for either outcome plus no usable shared session in that window.

Fixtures prioritize first scan, single next-day failed retry, Urgent, Repeat/Consult, maximum gap, trigger, routine deferral. Follow-up is measured from the last session to avoid daily resetting of due dates. Confirm this precedence and whether a failed retry can spawn another retry (fixtures say no).
Routine deferral in fixtures requires both Monitor tiers, usable measurements, and no recent trigger. An unresolved or poor assessment prevents deferral.
Area flag implies at least Repeat (Tier 2), but no LR is inferred from area. No red flags are randomly invented.

No automatic Urgent clearance is specified; Urgent remains sticky. Consult persists across technically inadequate scans, including readable degraded acquisitions; a lower quality-weighted estimate alone cannot clear a serious tier. Successful newer evidence can change Consult per the monitoring model.

Synthetic high/low susceptibility is hidden ground truth. Fixtures supply the associated starting prior as an explicitly synthetic preflight input; a real observable prior-assignment protocol still needs confirmation.
